subject: SIG: evidence and confirmation — prompt logs, retention, and training
messages:
From: Lisa Cheng <security@novamed.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: Clarify prompt logs & training on customer data

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking our SIG. A few clarifications we need for our security review before we proceed:
- How long are prompt texts and model responses retained by default?
- Are prompt logs or model outputs used to train or fine-tune models (internal or third party)?
- Do you have sample evidence we can review (masked prompt-log extract, SOC 2 attestation, network diagram)?
- Please point to the config or option that lets a customer opt-out of data usage for training.

We're on a compressed procurement timeline for this quarter. If you can confirm and send artifacts by EOD Tue that would be ideal — otherwise let us know an ETA.

Thanks,
Lisa Cheng
Sr. InfoSec Manager
NovaMed Technologies

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <security@novamed.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-07-19T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Clarify prompt logs & training on customer data

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; I attach a short SIG workbook and a masked prompt-log sample. We can expand any item on a compliance call.

1) Retention windows (default)
- Prompt content (user-provided text & generated output): not stored for training by default. Ephemeral buffering for active sessions only; persistent storage is disabled unless customer explicitly enables data retention.
- Operational telemetry/metrics & aggregated usage: retained for 90 days to support SLOs and billing, then aggregated and retained in anonymized form.

2) Training on customer data
- Redwood does NOT train or fine-tune shared model weights on customer prompts by default. Training on customer data requires an explicit opt-in contract and an opt-in setting in the Dedicated/Private product controls.

3) Prompt logs sample & evidence
- Attached: "prompt-log-sample-masked.txt" (timestamps partially redacted, PII removed) and latest "Redwood_SIG_Answers_v3.pdf" (SIG matrix answers).
- SOC 2 attestation is included (SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf).
- Network/infrastructure diagram attached as requested.

4) Customer configuration for opt-out
- Customers can toggle "Persist Prompts for Support/Analytics" at the project level in the Console; defaults to OFF. Documentation URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/privacy/prompt-retention (included in workbook).

Next steps: Rafael, Grace — can you please confirm the phrasing around encryption-at-rest for prompt logs and one-sentence on KMS key access (customer-managed KMS for Private deployments)? I want to include that exact language in the final SIG workbook we send Lisa.

Lisa — I can also schedule a 30-minute compliance walkthrough for Tue/Wed if that helps.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-07-20T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: finalize SIG wording + attachables

Rafael / Grace,

Quick follow-up after Lisa's ask. Draft language I put in the workbook needs the security team's confirmation so we don't overstate controls:
- "Prompt logs are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and access is gated by RBAC; for Private deployments customers may supply a customer-managed KMS key (HSM) and Redwood logs key access events to an immutable audit trail."
- "Default retention for prompt content is zero persistent days; operational traces kept for 90 days and are aggregated/anonymized thereafter."

Please review the attached draft snapshot (I uploaded to the Drive link) and confirm: (A) KMS wording ok, (B) whether we should change telemetry retention from 90 to 60 days for the SIG profile, and (C) approve the masked prompt-log sample for sharing.

Rafael — can you also add a single-sentence confirmation about not using customer prompts to train global models absent opt-in?

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Internal quick reply from Rafael:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-07-20T11:22:00-07:00

Tessa — quick thumbs up on the KMS wording. Suggest changing telemetry retention to 90 days (keep as-is) — it's aligned with our observability SLOs. Approve masked sample (we removed exact user identifiers and truncated client-specific keys). Adding sentence: "Redwood will not use customer-provided prompts or generated outputs to update or fine-tune shared model weights unless the customer signs an explicit training opt-in agreement."

Rafael

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <security@novamed.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-07-21T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final SIG artifacts & confirmation — NovaMed request

Hi Lisa,

Per our exchange, please find attached the finalized SIG workbook and evidence package. Key confirmations below (pulled directly from the workbook):
- Default persistent storage of prompt content for hosted customers: 0 days. Prompts are buffered in-memory for active requests only and are not written to persistent training datasets unless the customer enables retention.
- Operational telemetry (metrics, aggregated logs) retention: 90 days, then aggregated/anonymized for longer-term analytics.
- Training/Model updates: Redwood DOES NOT use customer prompts or generated outputs to train, fine-tune, or update shared public model weights without an explicit, documented opt-in agreement.
- Encryption & access controls: Prompt logs and any persisted artifacts are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Private deployments support customer-managed KMS and we log key access events for audit.

Attachments included: Redwood_SIG_Answers_v3.pdf, SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf, network-infrastructure-diagram.png, prompt-log-sample-masked.txt

If you'd like, we can coordinate a short call with our security and infra leads to walk through the SOC 2 scope and the architecture diagram. I also linked our HubSpot record for this opportunity (HS-23456) if you want to attach the artifacts to procurement.

Please confirm receipt and whether you need anything else for your security team.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
